## Activity

During October 2020, East City Eye Clinic completed 115 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing the service’s image quality and grading performance for the month. The recorded activity should be checked against local operational records as part of routine monitoring. Any issues affecting the capture process should be noted promptly so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There was 1 ungradable capture, giving an ungradable rate of 0.9. The clinic should continue to review image quality at regular intervals and identify any recurring causes of ungradable images. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 22 referable results during October 2020. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This indicates that grading was completed within a short operational timeframe for the month. The clinic should continue to monitor grading turnaround alongside image quality and referral outcomes, using the findings to support consistent service delivery and timely action where required.
